items.title: Call of Duty Movie Director Teases Story That Explores 'the Cost of War,' Praises Modern Warfare Characters
items.excerpt: Call of Duty movie director Peter Berg has teased more details from his live-action film, promising an adaptation with "a very strong soul" that explores "the cost of war."
items.content_text: Call of Duty movie director Peter Berg has teased more details from his live-action film, promising an adaptation with "a very strong soul" that explores "the cost of war." The filmmaker behind Skydance-Paramount's upcoming reimagining of Activision's massive first-person shooter series dived into his thoughts on the franchise during an interview with ComicBook . We already know the Call of Duty movie will focus on the Modern Warfare portion of the FPS universe , and it sounds like Berg and writer Taylor Sheridan have already looked to the games it's based on for inspiration. "So Modern Warfare, if you really look at the missions, and the storylines, and the characters – like Captain Price, and Soap, and Ghost, and Alex – these are complicated humans," Berg said. "These are not – and no disrespect – cartoon characters or comic books. These are very nuanced storylines; like, there's a real soul to the Modern Warfare universe… "And, yes, there's violence, and there's hardware, and equipment, and there's killing – but underneath it I think the game, and the craters of the game, are really looking at the cost of war, the cost of having to be a warrior who's, for whatever reason, chosen to put himself between real danger and the rest of us, and the burden that these guys carry." Berg seems to be putting in the work to nail a Modern Warfare story for the big screen, but not every fan is convinced that he's the right guy for the job . That's mostly because he had some not-so-nice things to say about gaming back in 2013. When asked for his take on video games based on war at the time, he said, called them "pathetic," using the term, "keyboard courage." "I think anyone that sits around playing video games for four hours... It's weak," Berg elaborated at the time. "Get out, do something." These days he's changed his tune, and judging by his affection for characters like Captain Price and Ghost, he's hoping to do right by Modern Warfare and its fans. His upcoming film, The Mosquito Bowl, is a sports-war film set to premiere later this month. His vision for the Call of Duty movie will start to take shape after that. "And that’s real stuff," Berg added when talking about Modern Warfare's connection to the real-life cost of war. "This is not just 'Hey, let’s shoot them all up and shoot popcorn!' Like, there’s a soul underneath it, that I understand that Taylor Sheridan understands, and I think probably not quite as graphically violent as Mosquito Bowl, but there will be a very strong soul, and consequence of war within the film, called 'duty.'" The Modern Warfare universe most recently expanded with the release of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 , which concluded Activision and Infinity Ward's reboot story when it launched yesterday. Its story has been called one of the darker entries the franchise has offered in recent memory. The Call of Duty movie, meanwhile, is set to come to theaters June 30, 2028. Additional plot details have not been revealed, though fans have already been busy sharing their hopes for who may play familiar (and unconfirmed) characters like Captain Price, Ghost, and more. It's a year that seems set to be big for video game adaptations, with an Elden Ring film also set to release a few months prior. A Battlefield movie is also in the works .

items.title: Elden Ring Movie's Budget Reportedly $200 Million, Almost 3x More Expensive Than A24's Marty Supreme
items.excerpt: Alex Garland's Elden Ring movie reportedly carries a hefty budget of almost $200 million, making it A24's most expensive movie ever – and it's not close.
items.content_text: Alex Garland's Elden Ring movie reportedly carries a hefty budget of almost $200 million, making it A24's most expensive movie ever – and it's not close. Background information on the live-action adaptation of FromSoftware and George R.R. Martin's 2022 RPG was shared in a Wall Street Journal report. The site stated that, according to its sources, Elden Ring's budget is "nearly $200 million." That makes it far and away the most expensive movie for the arthouse film-focused company, which has built a reputation for delivering memorable projects on more modest budgets for the last 14 years. Should Elden Ring's reported budget prove accurate, it would mean Garland's film falls in line with Marvel movies like Spider-Man: No Way Home ($200 million via Variety ) and Jurassic World Rebirth ($180 million via The Hollywood Reporter ). As seen in 2025's Marty Supreme , that's a far cry from A24's usual strategy. The Timothée Chalamet-led, Josh Safdie-directed drama made headlines ahead of its release for being the most expensive film the company had produced at $70 million (via Deadline ). That puts Elden Ring at nearly three times the cost of A24's next-most-expensive picture. Garland's Civil War supposedly cost $50 million before that, according to Variety . Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson's The Smashing Machine reportedly carried a similar budget. In other words, nothing really comes close to A24's first major swing in the world of video game movie adaptations . For now, we know little about Elden Ring ahead of its 2028 premiere, so it's hard to say exactly why it costs so much. Earlier this year, the movie studio announced the film had a pretty stacked cast, which includes familiar faces like Kit Connor (X-Men, Warfare), Cailee Spaeny (Alien: Romulus, Civil War), Nick Offerman (The Last of Us, Parks and Recreation), Havana Rose Liu (Tuner, Bottoms), and more. Early production photos then teased faithful recreations of some iconic sets, with more making their way to the internet not long after . The Elden Ring movie's big budget may not have always been the plan for what's shaping up to, one way or another, be a massive release for A24. Previous reports had the live-action fantasy flick pinned at just more than $100 million , suggesting either that initial rumors were inaccurate or Garland's budget somehow ballooned over the course of production. Filming finally wrapped in July of this year. The Elden Ring movie was announced in May 2025 and is expected to premiere March 3, 2028. It will probably be a little while longer before we see any official images or a trailer, so in the meantime, you can read about how actor and Dark Souls superfan Peter Serafinowicz landed a role in the film .

items.title: Avengers: Doomsday Teaser Reveals Who Was Edited Out of the First Trailer, Fans Say
items.excerpt: Marvel fans say the new Avengers: Doomsday teaser might have revealed who was edited out of its first trailer.
items.content_text: Marvel fans say the new Avengers: Doomsday teaser might have revealed who was edited out of its first trailer. Marvel Studios didn't not reveal more from its December team-up movie when the Doomsday baseball teaser premiered during Game 1 of the 2026 World Series last night. Focusing more on letting Pedro Pascal's Reed Richards throw Joseph Quinn's Johnny Storm a stretchy pitch as MLB players did their best to fit in, the minute-long TV spot felt more like a cute crossover than an opportunity for new footage – but that doesn't mean fans aren't still all over it. In between the shots of the Fantastic Four's Earth-828 are, occasionally, what amounts to a few precious seconds of new footage from Avengers: Doomsday. With less than two months left to go until the premiere, Marvel really only took the time to highlight some funny interactions between Steve Rogers (Chris Evans) and characters like Ant-Man (Paul Rudd) and Thor (Chris Hemsworth). Worlds collide ⚾ An exclusive preview of Marvel's new Avengers movie assembles Bryce Harper, Freddie Freeman, Jacob Misiorowski, Junior Caminero and Randy Arozarena 👀 Avengers: Doomsday arrives in theaters everywhere December 18 https://t.co/WX1YtKjAKt — MLB (@MLB) October 24, 2026 It's…not much. While you might think Steve taking a jab at Thor while wielding Mjolnir is the standout moment, some eagle-eyed fans think it's the scene the former Captain America shares with Ant-Man that we should be paying attention to. Let's take a step back. You might remember Marvel fans doing what they do best by looking for clues tucked into the original Doomsday trailer . One shot that caught a lot of attention was an image showing the New Avengers having a meeting with old heroes and the Fantastic Four . A gap between the Earth-828 heroes led many to believe Marvel had, as it's been known to do before, edited out an important character from the scene. The World Series teaser took viewers back and showed that scene from a new perspective, bringing Steve Rogers along as a plus one. The quick shot of Evans' character showed that he's almost certainly standing next to Ebon Moss-Bachrach's Ben Grimm as he does his best to entertain Scott Lang. With Evans unseen in the previously questionable look at the scene, Marvel fans believe Steve Rogers was the character Marvel was trying to hide all along. Steve being next to Ben confirms he was edited out of the first trailer. He is next to Ben, Sam and Scott by u/Kanozx in MCUTheories Steve being next to Ben confirms he was edited out of the first trailer. He is next to Ben, Sam and Scott https://t.co/FS8To3Z7nt — Shaane (@bussdownhendrix) October 24, 2026 "Yup, and Doom is edited out too," another fan said , referencing a theory that Doctor Doom may appear as an ally during the events of the film. "I wonder if they will show it in the trailers, hopefully they do just a tiny bit." And ta-da: We finally seem to have our answer – but why? Why would Marvel edit out a character that fans are already well aware had a role to play in Doomsday? It's confusing, especially considering Steve does eventually show up later in the trailer he's believed to have been edited out of. On the other side of things are those still trying to determine if the person we've seen wielding Mjolnir is even Steve Rogers at all. One popular fan theory that has gained more traction as Evans' role is once again put under the microscope is that his character is actually Tom Hiddleston's Loki in disguise. Some also suspect that the original trailer wasn't ever edited in the first place, with this new footage simply showing the same scene but a few seconds before or after that shot of questionable positioning. Was Marvel playing with its hero positioning just to give its first trailer a bit more punch toward the end, is there more mystery to solve, or are fans maybe looking too much into things? That's the main conversation fans are having in the aftermath of just a few frames of new Doomsday footage. Holdup https://t.co/A3arrek86n — Best of Marvel (@BestMarvelU) October 24, 2026 this sounds exactly like something Loki would say to Thor as steve rogers 😭 https://t.co/OUEmvJubQu — hailey* ౨ৎ (@sentrynation) October 24, 2026 "In the new trailer, I can't be the only one, Steve's face or something looks weird like it kept changing in each scene or something else," one theorist said . "I can't quite put my finger on it but something about him is off." As ridiculous as some of this might sound, Marvel has absolutely played with pre-release footage to throw fans off the scent of big reveals before. Marketing materials released in the lead-up to Avengers: Infinity War in 2018 provide a few of the most notable examples, with many seemingly important scenes featured in trailers completely cut from the final version of the film. Searching for potential edits with a fine-tooth comb is also something Marvel fans did ahead of the release of Spider-Man: Brand New Day . Unfortunately, we'll have to wait until Avengers: Doomsday comes to theaters december 18, 2026, to find out which theories are correct and which ones didn't quite pan out. In the meantime, you can read about the latest addition to the film's already-stacked cast. You can also see how David Harbour did his best to walk back potentially spoiler-y comments he made earlier this year.

items.title: 12 Anime Worth Watching This Fall
items.excerpt: From a return to Night City to a legendary blacksmith and bizarre race, we run down the new and returning anime titles you need to check out.
items.content_text: A return to Night City, a legendary blacksmith, and a bizarre race are what you can expect this fall anime season. There's a new season full of anime to check out this Fall like the return of the award-winning Cyberpunk Edgerunners , the hilarious Overgeared, and the highly anticipated continuation of Steel Ball Run JoJo's Bizarre Adventure . Across Crunchyroll, HIDIVE, Hulu, and Netflix, as well as others, there are a lot of places to enjoy anime at the moment. Check out some anticipated series in the video above or the slideshow gallery below, followed by the full list of new Fall season 2026 anime and where to watch them in the U.S. and their respective streaming platforms. Anime listed are available now unless otherwise stated. Aoashi Season 2 (Crunchyroll) The highly anticipated sports series Aoashi returns with Season 2! It’s been a few years now since we last saw Ashito and teammates attempt to rise through the ranks of the Tokyo City football club. Now that Ashito has made a good showing, the competition ramps up yet again. TMS Entertainment, known for Dr. Stone and Yowamushi Pedal, takes up the animation production reins this season. Unlike Blue Lock, but similar to Haikyu, Aoashi is much more grounded. So if you’re a fan of sports anime along those lines, now’s the time to get on the pitch and check this out. Aoashi Season 2 is available now on Crunchyroll. Blue Box Season 2 (Netflix) Speaking of sports anime, Blue Box is back with its Season 2! This sports anime also has romance, so there’s been quite a bit of drama since we last saw Taiki and the gang navigate their feelings. Electric Circus, a newer studio composed of some former Telecom Animation Film staff, is taking on animation production this season. We can’t wait to see how these relationships progress this fall after leaving us with major decisions last season. If you’re looking to take a break from the many action-packed series out now, this series is worth checking out. Blue Box Season 2 is available now on Netflix. Firefly Wedding (Crunchyroll) A new romance series dropping this fall is Firefly Wedding. The series follows Satoko, the daughter of a prestigious family who is navigating marriage proposals while dealing with a secret health issue. After an unfortunate event, she negotiates for her life by proposing marriage to a killer. David Production, known for JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure and Fire Force, is at the helm of this series, so expect some crazy action as these spouses-to-be prepare for an unlikely wedding. Firefly Wedding is available now on Crunchyroll. Overgeared (Crunchyroll) Looking for a fun fantasy series this fall? Overgeared is the anime for you this season! The series follows Shin, a player in a popular fantasy VR game which offers opportunities to make money in the real world. He’s been struggling for a while now, but falls upon a once-in-a-lifetime chance to become a legendary blacksmith class. With these newfound abilities, he can turn around his luck even though he isn’t super exceptional in other categories. J.C. Staff, the studio behind The Disastrous Life of Saiki K. and Bakuman, is handling animation production on this series. So far, it’s been a hilarious ride as Shin learns more about his class and how he can use it in this dangerous fantasy game world. If you have time outside the big returning anime this season, check out this new series. Overgeared is available now on Crunchyroll. The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life (Crunchyroll) Another new fantasy series this season is The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life. The series follows Rein, an enchanter who gets laid off from his guild after serving his purpose. Soon after, he takes back all his enchantments and imbues his own plain gear with the same magic, making him a force to be reckoned with. P.A. Works, known for Shirobako and Skip to Loafer, is heading animation on this new series. Seeing Rein dive head first into an adventure without any clue of what he’s doing has been the highlight this early in the season. It’s an especially good time when his newfound ally, Lily, freaks out about all the careless chaos he brings. The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life is available now on Crunchyroll. Psyren (Crunchyroll) The supernatural 2007 manga Psyren is getting an anime adaptation this fall season. The series follows Ageha, a young student who tries to help a friend and unknowingly gets involved with a mysterious world filled with monsters. Satelight, the studio behind Log Horizon and Macross F, is taking on production for this long-awaited series. If you’re interested in seeing what the fuss is about after all these years, you can check out Psyren, available now on Crunchyroll. Fool Night (Netflix) - Premieres 11/26 One of the most striking anime this fall season is Fool Night. The series follows Toshiro, a struggling man contemplating difficult choices in a dystopian world trapped in constant darkness. Since there’s no sunlight, society has developed a way to sustain life and oxygen by turning humans into plants. The studios behind Mobile Suit Gundam and March Comes in Like a Lion, Sunrise and Shaft, are joining forces for what looks to be a visually impressive anime. Based on the teasers so far, there is a beautiful emphasis on lights in this dark world. Alongside the body horror of the plant technology, there are some intriguing bits here to get sci-fans excited for the upcoming premiere. Fool Night will be available on Netflix November 26. Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 (Netlfix) Speaking of dystopian worlds, Cyberpunk Edgerunners returns with a Season 2 this fall! The series has a whole new cast of characters this time around, so we may or may not see someone like Lucy this season. Studio Trigger returns yet again to this award-winning series, and it shows in what we’ve seen so far. Between the amazing character designs and the gritty Night City action, Season 2 is looking to impress yet again. Cyberpunk Edgerunners Season 2 is available now on Netflix. Black Clover Season 2 (Crunchyroll) The highly anticipated return of Black Clover is finally here with Season 2! It’s been about five years since we last saw Asta and friends, and here they prepare to rescue their beloved captain from the latest big baddie. Studio Pierrot is back again to lead animation production, so expect more of the sleek, action-packed battles we’ve seen before. If you’re interested in the series, there’s a bit of catching up to do, but now’s the time to really get into this popular shonen series. Black Clover Season 2 is available now on Crunchyroll. Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc (Hulu) Another long-awaited return this season is Tokyo Revengers with the War of the Three Titans Arc. Last time around with Takemichi and friends, we saw major reveals as his secret got around; there was also a pivotal demise that viewers have been wondering about ever since. LIDENFILMS, the studio behind Call of the Night and Kotaro Lives Alone, is back again to helm this arc as well. It’ll be interesting to see where our protagonist goes from here now that a major player is behind him as he continues his time-traveling investigation. Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc is available now on Hulu. The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 (Crunchyroll) The award-winning Apothecary Diaries is back this year with Season 3. Last we saw Maomao and friends, the Imperial Palace faced one of its biggest threats we’ve seen so far regarding a devious plot within its walls. OLM studios, known for Odd Taxi and Berserk, returns to manage animation production. From what we’re seeing so far this early in the season, our eclectic group is out of the frying pan and into the fire with another major problem on the horizon in addition to the fallout of last season. We’re looking forward to seeing how Maomao gets out of these binds this time around as the season progresses. The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 is available now on Crunchyroll. Steel Ball Run JoJo's Bizarre Adventure 2nd - 3rd Stage (Netflix) Finally after what felt like forever with the one-episode tease earlier this year, Steel Ball Run JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure returns with the 2nd and 3rd Stage. We just met Johnny Joestar alongside some quirky characters during the first leg of the cross-country race. In typical bizarre fashion, crazy shenanigans between racers will surely ensue in and out of the race. David Production continues where they left off, using the extra time to no doubt knock this series out of the park. If you still haven’t tried out this eccentric series, now is a pretty good time to give it a shot. Steel Ball Run JoJo's Bizarre Adventure 2nd - 3rd Stage is available now on Netflix. items.title: Avengers: Doomsday Promoted With Baseball-Themed Crossover Featuring MLB Players During World Series
items.excerpt: Marvel Studios debuted a unique promo for Avengers: Doomsday during Game 1 of the 2026 World Series on Fox tonight between the Milwaukee Brewers and Tampa Bay Rays. The ad is an Avengers-MLB crossover set on Earth-828 at Ebbets Field (the former home of the Dodgers when they were in Brooklyn; it was torn down on our Earth in 1960 – the promo is seemingly set in the same time period as The Fantastic Four: First Steps, as you can see New York Giants players in the background).
items.content_text: Marvel Studios debuted a unique promo for Avengers: Doomsday during Game 1 of the 2026 World Series on Fox tonight between the Milwaukee Brewers and Tampa Bay Rays. The ad is an Avengers-MLB crossover set on Earth-828 at Ebbets Field (the former home of the Dodgers when they were in Brooklyn; it was torn down on our Earth in 1960 – the promo is seemingly set in the same time period as The Fantastic Four: First Steps, as you can see New York Giants players in the background). In it, Mr. Fantastic, sporting a Brooklyn Dodgers cap, takes the mound to throw a stretchy-armed first pitch while The Thing hypes up the players as current, modern MLB players Freddie Freeman, Jacob Misiorowski, Bryce Harper, Randy Arozarena, and Junior Caminero look on from the sidelines. They're interrupted when Dr. Doom attacks from the sky, with clips from the film interspersed throughout the promo. Worlds collide ⚾An exclusive preview of Marvel's new Avengers movie assembles Bryce Harper, Freddie Freeman, Jacob Misiorowski, Junior Caminero and Randy Arozarena 👀Avengers: Doomsday arrives in theaters everywhere December 18 https://t.co/WX1YtKjAKt — MLB (@MLB) October 24, 2026 Live sporting events, such as the Super Bowl, NBA Finals, and World Series remain one of Hollywood's favorite mediums to debut new trailers and promote films, as in the age of streaming and on-demand content, they're one of the few forms of programming that consistently drive a live, tuned-in audience. Avengers: Doomsday returns Chris Evans as Steve Rogers (which is referenced in a clip from the film used in the MLB promo), while Robert Downey Jr. trades Iron Man's mask for Dr. Doom's and appears to be abducting heroes in the upcoming film (though we will see RDJ as Stark at least one more time, starting in 2028 at Disney California Adventure's upcoming Avengers: Infinity Defense ride ). Much of it remains shrouded in mystery, such that even actors in the film don't know what happens . Audience interest appears to be strong, as ticket pre-sales are outpacing those of this summer's blockbuster hit Spider-Man: Brand New Day. But Marvel recommends you do your homework before heading to the theater for Doomsday.

items.title: Aaron Paul Makes Surprise Cameo in DC’s Clayface
items.excerpt: Three-time Emmy winner Aaron Paul has a blink and you’ll miss it cameo in the new DC movie Clayface. Now, the film’s director, James Watkins, has revealed why the Breaking Bad and Westworld star is in DC’s first R-rated horror movie.
items.content_text: Spoilers follow for Clayface, which is now playing in theaters. Three-time Emmy winner Aaron Paul has a blink and you’ll miss it cameo in the new DC movie Clayface . Now, the film’s director, James Watkins, has revealed why the Breaking Bad and Westworld star is in DC’s first R-rated horror movie. Paul plays Jimmy “One Nut” Hagen, the late abusive father of protagonist Matt Hagen (Tom Rhys Harries). Word of Paul’s casting was first reported by Feature First back in June. Paul’s cameo occurs during the climactic action sequence set at the Gotham City nightclub Vesuvius where Matt confronts the gangsters who disfigured him. Matt finds the hood who killed his dad and morphs into his father to shock the killer. More From Gotham City Clayface Review Everything We Know About the DCU's Batman Every Upcoming DC Movie and TV Show (and a Few That Have Been Cancelled Too) Paul originally had a larger supporting role in Clayface, appearing in flashbacks to Matt’s youth, but the filmmakers ultimately cut nearly all of those scenes. Paul’s appearance in the nightclub is all that remains of his role. “In terms of trying to figure out the character, it was, How much is Matt defined by his past and how much is he an everyman?” Watkins told Entertainment Weekly . “At one point, we were looking at it and thinking, Is it the ‘sins of the father’? But actually, as we worked on the script, I thought that notion of revenge was more universal and more relatable to all of us. It doesn’t matter whether you’re carrying a trauma or any of that. If we’re slighted, we carry this sense of being wronged and we all want to do something, but generally in life we can’t do anything about it and we’re powerless.” As EW points out, rather than having Matt haunted by his dad he instead weaponizes the memory of his father against his enemies. “He’s probably also saying, ‘No, I’m not my father,’” said Watkins. For more on the film, read my Clayface review , our Clayface ending explained , and catch up on everything we know so far about the DCU’s Batman .

items.title: Dead by Daylight to Remove Chucky Content Just Months After Losing Michael Myers
items.excerpt: Dead by Daylight fans are beside themselves after Behaviour Interactive announced that all Chucky content would no longer be available to purchase starting next month.
items.content_text: Dead by Daylight fans are beside themselves after Behaviour Interactive announced that all Chucky content would no longer be available to purchase starting next month. The developer behind the popular asymmetrical horror game confirmed plans to pull the Chucky Chapter from sale in posts shared across social media. The message followed rumors that the possessed killer doll would soon be removed from the game, with the official statement promising that those who have purchased related content will be able to use it even after it is removed from shelves starting November 24, 2026. "We welcomed The Good Guy out of his box and into The Fog nearly three years ago, but it's now time for the Chucky Chapter to leave the shelf," Behaviour said . "On November 24, 2026, the Chapter and its associated content will be removed from in-game and first-party stores. Any content unlocked before that date will remain available to use in-game." As detailed in an FAQ post shared by the developers, these changes to the Chucky Chapter mean a few things for Dead by Daylight players. Its Killer, known in-game as The Good Guy, will no longer be available to purchase, though bug fixes will still be supported. The collection of outfits and cosmetics he's gained since being added in 2023 will also be made unavailable, and no future add-ons for the character will be added. In other words, if you're a Chucky fan who's been waiting to pull the trigger, you might want to start thinking about it. To help ease players into the idea of losing one of Dead by Daylight's most unique Killers, Behaviour is holding a sale for all items related to the Chucky Chapter starting Monday, October 26. The "Last Chance" sale runs until his November 24 removal date and slashes prices by 50% across all platforms. Dead by Daylight and its collection of Killers has often been referred to as 'horror Super Smash Bros.' by fans, but Behaviour has plenty of experience when it comes to pulling Killers. Hellraiser's Pinhead was pulled from digital storefronts in 2025 after first joining in 2021. Halloween's Michael Myers, the first major playable Killer to join Dead by Daylight after its launch in 2016, was removed this past January. @DeadbyDaylight I THOUGHT WE HAD A NICE LICENSE AGREEMENT!!!!! https://t.co/bOMgT44DQt — Freaky Nikki For DBD (@Ghostface_4_MK1) October 23, 2026 Although Behaviour refrained from sharing more details about why exactly the Child's Play rep is being removed, fans usually assume licensing issues are to blame. Hellraiser and Halloween both received new game announcements in Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival and Halloween: The Game that just happened to arrive around the time their respective properties were pulled from Dead by Daylight. Friday the 13th's infamous licensing kerfuffle is also allegedly what kept Jason Voorhees out of The Fog for years before he finally joined a few months back. Stranger Things is another example, with its first chapter's Demogorgon content removed before returning in 2023 . Like Chucky, players who purchased pulled content can still use it freely even after it's removed from stores, but that doesn't mean other players can't feel the impact. Content being removed from purchase not only means that players won't be able to buy it in the future; it means that content will likely show up less frequently during matches. Comment by u/DeadByDaylight_Dev from discussion in deadbydaylight That affects just about everyone who likes having their Survivor matches shaken up by new Killer abilities to keep them on their toes, as a player doesn't need to have purchased a chapter to play against its respective Killer. Considering Michael Myers left Dead by Daylight earlier this year and Pinhead was removed not much longer before that, players are feeling Chucky's pull from sale more than many of the previous Killer removals. "Hold a license challenge: impossible," one fan said . "How do you keep losing licenses bro?" another fan speculated . "I thought you had a good relationship. Chucky had many skins WTF :(" goodbye chuckster. i will always love you https://t.co/h6sUaDGrwI — Demo🌸 (@RatLivers) October 23, 2026 Again, Behaviour has not explicitly stated why new players will not be able to purchase Chucky after that November cutoff date. IGN has reached out to the Dead by Daylight team for comment. "This makes me so sad," one player on Reddit said . "Chucky is such a huge license and we've lost Michael and Pinhead already within the last two years. Not blaming BHVR for it, I get it's business. It just sucks." "It's strange though. You'd assume they'd change their contractual agreements after losing Demogorgon the first time to prevent this from happening with recent Killers," another replied . "Michael/Pinhead are a bit understandable since those were older licenses, but I'd assume Chucky would've had a proactive contractual agreement to prevent this from happening?" Although losing three Killers in the span of a year and a half might sting, Behaviour has continued to add new notable characters and franchises into the mix. After Tokyo Ghoul's Ken Kaneki and Five Nights at Freddy's Springtrap were added last year, the studio brought Stranger Things villain Vecna into The Fog. Jason joined in the summer of this year, and Terrifier's Art the Clown will be added next month. Although the majority of the game's licensed Killers have remained available for years and are still available to this day, how long they will remain available for purchase is unclear.
items.title_en: Dead by Daylight to Remove Chucky Content Just Months After Losing Michael Myers

items.title: Barnes & Noble Has the First 500-Piece Dungeon Crawler Carl Jigsaw Puzzle for Sale
items.content_text: The Dungeon Crawler Carl series has blown up this year in many ways, but it's the incredibly fast expansion into merchandise has been truly impressive for the franchise. There are T-shirts, graphic novels, action figures, tabletop games, and even a halloween costume available to buy already, but now you can add jigsaw puzzles to that list. With the popularity of the upcoming tabletop adaptations from Renegade studios, it's not surprising to see Matt Dinniman's LitRPG story getting the puzzle treatment. The 500-piece puzzle is the highest piece-count available, though, so you'll have to wait for more options if you're looking for a challenge. items.title: Avengers: Doomsday Casts Sandra Hüller in Cameo Role
items.excerpt: Marvel has reportedly cast Sandra Hüller in Avengers: Doomsday for a secret cameo role.
items.content_text: Marvel has reportedly cast Sandra Hüller in Avengers: Doomsday for a secret cameo role. Information about the last-minute addition comes from The Hollywood Reporter , which said the Project Hail Mary star will appear on screens when Earth's Mightiest Heroes take on Robert Downey Jr.'s Doctor Doom this December. Although much of that cast and their parts in the movie have been confirmed, details about Hüller's role were not shared. Marvel Studios and directors Joe and Anthony Russo almost certainly have plans for plenty of superhero moments and surprises. How Hüller fits into that plan remains to be seen, but considering fans had already speculated about her involvement in recent days, some of the less patient Marvel Cinematic Universe enjoyers are probably already doing their best to piece together Doomsday's mysteries early. Hüller is a German actor with a decades-long career on movie and TV screens. She was nominated for Actress in a Leading Role at the 2024 Oscars for her part in Anatomy of a Fall, but is also known for her parts in films like Digger, The Zone of Interest, and Fatherland. If you missed her in any of those movies, there's a good chance you caught her playing Eva Stratt, a role that we called one of the best parts of Ryan Gosling's Project Hail Mary . As for her Marvel introduction, all we know for now is that she'll appear in a cameo part, meaning she probably won't show up for much of its 2-hour-and-45-minute runtime . Like major stars – including Harry Styles and Charlize Theron – before her, it's possible that we could only see Hüller's character during a stinger moment shown during the film's credits sequence. There's at least little reason to suspect that's not on the table, especially considering Marvel will use Doomsday's plot to set up the release of Avengers: Secret Wars in December 2027. Doomsday is out in just a few short months, but that clearly hasn't stopped Marvel from revealing new information for what's gearing up to be one of the year's biggest releases. Even more about the movie is expected to be revealed at the MLB World Series , which is just a few hours after this piece's publication. THR noted that the Russo brothers are knee-deep in post-production for the film ahead of its December 18, 2026, premiere. Avengers: Doomsday will bring the Avengers, X-Men, Fantastic Four, and more when it arrives in a few months. Until then, you can read what Jeremy Renner had to say about the good guys' chances without Hawkeye . You can also see how David Harbour did his best to walk back what may have been an early spoiler . Photo by Matt Crossick/Variety via Getty Images.

items.title: Xbox's First-Ever Chief Operating Officer Leaves Role Just Three Months After It Was Created
items.excerpt: Helen Chiang, Xbox’s first-ever chief operating officer, is no longer in the role just three months after it was created, as told by CEO Asha Sharma in an internal memo today.
items.content_text: Helen Chiang, Xbox’s first-ever chief operating officer, is no longer in the role just three months after it was created, as told by CEO Asha Sharma in an internal memo today. The memo, verified by The Verge , included a brief statement from Sharma regarding Chiang’s exit. “Helen Chiang is leaving Microsoft today. I’m grateful for her years of service and wish her well,” Sharma said. “We’ll share more on COO leadership as plans are finalized.” Chiang had been with Xbox for an astonishing 21 years. Previously, she was in charge of the Minecraft franchise, and shifted roles to chief operating officer in July 2026. The reason for Chiang’s promotion and the job duties of the COO were outlined in a statement by Sharma amid news of Xbox’s massive restructuring this summer. According to Sharma, the role was necessary to “work toward a shared goal, make the right tradeoffs, and get things done” as Xbox’s headcount grew and the company became “more fragmented.” “For the first time, we are establishing a Chief Operating Officer with end-to-end P&L responsibility across content, hardware, platform, and services. Helen Chiang has been promoted to this role and will report directly to me,” Sharma said at the time. “Over nearly two decades at Xbox, Helen has helped build some of our most important businesses, from Xbox Live to leading Mojang and the Minecraft franchise. She will bring our businesses together under one operating model, making sure we make clear investment decisions, learn from our successes and failures, and hold ourselves accountable for results.” As noted by The Verge, the reason for Chiang’s brief tenure in this specific role has not yet been divulged, but it’s certainly a striking move, given her 21 years with the company prior to this. Xbox is predicted to continue layoffs as part of its ongoing internal restructuring, with 3,200 total employees expected to lose their jobs this year. Several studios have been divested as a result of this rework, though some have managed to find their footing, as is the case with Double Fine . Others, however, remain in limbo; Arkane Lyon, the studio that’s currently working on Marvel’s Blade , faces closure as soon as mid-November if a buyer isn’t found. The studio was also impacted by the reshuffling at Microsoft, leaving both fans and industry insiders biting their nails in hope that the project finds a new home. Other companies in the games industry aren’t faring any better. Just this week, EA announced the closure of 30-year-old RPG powerhouse BioWare , known for making games like Dragon Age, Jade Empire, and Mass Effect. The next Mass Effect game was also canceled, prompting worldwide outcry from players and calls for a boycott. A full-length trailer for the game was also leaked online, rubbing more salt in the wound thanks to just how fantastic it looked. And while fans are crossing their fingers that EA either sells BioWare’s IP or hands them over to another studio, analysts say this isn’t likely. Oh, well — at least the Prime Video series is still alive.

items.title: Indie Game Dev Takes Down Vibe-Coded Zombie Shooter After San Francisco Officials Condemn 'Dehumanizing' Game
items.excerpt: The developer of a zombie game set in San Francisco has removed the game from online marketplaces and issued a public apology after city officials condemned the title for depicting its homeless people as ‘zombies.’
items.content_text: The developer of a zombie game set in San Francisco has taken down the game and issued a public apology after city officials condemned the title for depicting its citizens as ‘zombies.’ Tenderloin Night Shift was a vibe-coded, first-person shooter created by independent developer Pierre-Louis Biojout over the course of a weekend using OpenAI’s Codex. As you’ve probably inferred by its title, the game takes place in San Francisco’s Tenderloin neighborhood, an area infamous for its high crime rates and unhoused population that’s often compared offhandedly to Los Angeles’s Skid Row. In the game, players use a gun to rid the Tenderloin of ‘zombies.’ Some of these undead enemies wear construction uniforms or whiz by on motorized scooters, while others wear food delivery backpacks, having clearly been infected while on the job. Still others are depicted doing the ‘fentanyl fold,’ a position where the body is bent forward at the waist, most usually displayed by fentanyl users who seem to have been frozen while standing upright. “San Francisco couldn’t fix the tenderloin, so I monetized it,” Biojout said on social media. In the game, he sold digital ad space for $100 per week, which accounts for some of the real-world companies seen on billboards within his polygonal recreation of the neighborhood. It didn’t take long for San Francisco city officials to take notice of the title. Speaking to NCB Bay Area , Mayor Daniel Lurie said, “There’s no accounting for taste or people’s terrible ideas. This is a bad one, and we reject it. It doesn’t speak for San Francisco values.” In a statement to the San Francisco Chronicle, Supervisor Bilal Mahmood, who represents the Tenderloin, dubbed the game “deeply disturbing and unacceptable.” “Turning violence against real people, including unhoused people, into entertainment is dehumanizing and should never be normalized,” he said. “I’m encouraged to see that the majority of San Franciscans recognize that this crosses a line and refuse to stand for it.” While Biojout was previously boasting about the backlash on his social media accounts, he later removed the game from his online platform and issued a public apology over how his project depicted San Francisco’s citizens. He also revealed that he’d been inspired by an Alcatraz-themed Call of Duty map and said he often passes by the Tenderloin on his way to work. “The game was not intended to provoke or to depict shooting real people. Its characters draw on a broad cross-section of San Francisco, across different backgrounds and walks of life, including people who work in tech. The familiar city details and Easter eggs are part of what makes it fun to play with friends,” he told the Chronicle . Speaking to NBC Bay Area, Bijout said, “It was not intended to depict shooting real people or to target a particular demographic or group.” Additionally, Biojout revealed that he refunded advertisers who promoted his game and removed all of his social media posts about it. He also donated the game’s total revenue to the Delancey Street Foundation , a nonprofit organization based in San Francisco that provides rehabilitation services and vocational training to convicted criminals and those suffering from substance abuse. “I built and posted a zombie game set on San Francisco streets. The setting and the way I promoted it showed poor judgment. Targeting people struggling with addiction or homelessness was never my intention,” he wrote on Twitter/X . The game was available on Biojout's NanoCorp AI website, a platform that runs online businesses using AI agents. It has since been removed, and the page is no longer available at the time of writing. items.title: Zendaya Sets Best Actress Oscar Campaign for Dune: Part 3

items.content_text: Zendaya will reportedly campaign in the Best Actress category for her role as Chani in Dune: Part III in the upcoming Oscars race. “The move marks a shift from the first two films, where she was positioned in supporting actress,” said Variety . “The decision reflects Chani’s expanded role in the story.” This larger, different role for Zendaya’s character in Dune: Part III has not gone unnoticed. IGN’s Jesse Schedeen recently wrote that “everything we’ve seen of Dune: Part Three so far suggests Chani is playing a vastly different role compared to the source material [Frank Herbert’s book Dune Messiah]. Her status quo is completely different. She isn’t Paul’s faithful concubine, pining for the day she can proudly bear his children. She’s rejected Paul and everything he stands for, preferring instead to live as a true Fremen, totally free and a servant to no one.” It should be noted that none of the actors in either of the past two Dune movies have earned either an Oscar or a Golden Globe nomination for those films. Both Dune movies, however, were nominated in technical categories. Zendaya has enjoyed a stellar year as an actor , earning praise for The Drama and starring in the two highest-grossing movies of 2026, Spider-Man: Brand New Day and The Odyssey . The leading entertainment industry awards prognosticators at GoldDerby , however, don’t have Zendaya as a hopeful in either of the Oscars’ actress categories for any of her films. (They currently have her Odyssey co-stars Anne Hathaway and Samantha Morton as the leading contenders to earn a Best Supporting Actress nomination for that film.) GoldDerby does, however, have Zendaya in the running for a Golden Globe nomination as Best Film Comedy/Musical Actress for The Drama and as TV Drama Actress for the final season of Euphoria . They also have her in the running for a Screen Actors Guild nomination as TV Drama Actress for Euphoria. The Academy recently altered their rules ahead of next year’s Oscars, including updating their positions on AI and allowing multiple nominations for the same actor in the same category. The 99th Academy Awards will air live on ABC and Hulu on Sunday, March 14, 2027, at 7 p.m. ET/4 p.m. PT. It will be the third year in a row that Conan O’Brien has hosted the Oscars ceremony.

items.title: Alien: Covenant Follow-Up Adds Prisoners Writer Aaron Guzikowski
items.excerpt: A sequel to Ridley Scott's Alien: Covenant is reportedly in the works with Prisoners writer Aaron Guzikowski.
items.content_text: A follow-up to Ridley Scott's Alien: Covenant is reportedly in the works with Prisoners writer Aaron Guzikowski. A continuation of the sci-fi horror franchise has started to pick up steam, according to The Hollywood Reporter . Scott is in the mix as a producer, with Guzikowski, who previously worked with Scott on HBO's Raised by Wolves , set to pen its script. The new Alien film seems to be in its early stages, with much of its plot remaining a secret for now. However, the report did state that it will not be a sequel to 2024's Alien: Romulus and is instead expected to share ties with Scott's Prometheus and Alien: Covenant films. The plan is for its story to include Michael Fassbender's David, though the actor is not attached to return quite yet. No director has been chosen for now, with Scott only involved as a producer along with Scott Free's Michael Pruss. THR said Scott specifically went to Guzikowski to help get the ball rolling on the project, which he announced in August. Although there is much work to be done, there is no doubt a large section of Scott fans who will be happy to see more from David the Android. Fassbender first played the character in 2012's Prometheus before returning for its Covenant sequel in 2017. As other Alien projects have come and gone in the years since, how Scott might finish his offshoot trilogy largely remained a mystery. As for Alien: Romulus, a sequel to the Cailee Spaeny and David Jonsson-starring horror movie was said to still be in limbo. Scott said in August that he thought the first film "was OK" when confirming he intended to return to the franchise because it "needs some help." Although a proper follow-up was said to be in the works as of late 2024, all we've really heard since then is that Fede Alvarez would produce – not direct – whatever came next. For now, information about the next Alien movie's cast and plot is unclear. While we wait for Scott and Guzikowski to deliver updates, you can read about the long history of Alien and Predator crossovers .

items.title: Mass Effect Fans Call for EA Boycott as Petition to Save BioWare's Canceled Game Garners More than 75,000 Signatures
items.excerpt: Mass Effect fans are calling for a boycott of all EA products and services in protest of the company closing down BioWare and canceling the next Mass Effect game.
items.content_text: Mass Effect fans are calling for a boycott of all EA products and services in protest of the company closing down BioWare and canceling the next Mass Effect game. It’s a rough time for Mass Effect fans. On October 21, EA announced its plans to shut down BioWare , a 30-year-old studio that spearheaded RPGs in the West with titles like Dragon Age, Jade Empire, Baldur’s Gate, and of course, Mass Effect . Players were eagerly awaiting news of the next game in BioWare’s beloved sci-fi franchise — but EA shut that down, too, revealing in a statement that the project was officially canceled. In the two days since then, fans of BioWare and the Mass Effect series have gathered together to call for action, begging EA to at least sell off BioWare’s IP to other studios rather than letting them languish. In fact, tensions have become so strained that players are now calling for an outright boycott of EA’s products and services until something is done. On Reddit, several threads are rallying Mass Effect fans to gather under the hashtag #savemasseffect, urging players to take action and make their voices heard. “WE HAVE TO DO SOMETHING! Guys we have to start something here and cry out loud enough that this game can be saved. Either EA making it or selling it off. We have to do it now before the noise on this game quiets down and it becomes another cancelled series, never to return,” one Redditor wrote . “I suggest we start a movement, and message the hell out of EA asking for some kind of outcome that gets this game finished. THIS GAME FINISHED.” “Mass Effect is one of the better RPGs out today,” another fan wrote in a post titled ‘EA Boycott!’ “...Unless they sell Mass Effect to another studio or bring it back. I will never buy another EA product ever. They are already not one of my favorite studios. No more Respawn Entertainment, DICE, Motive Studios, Criterion Games, Maxis, Full Circle, Cliffhanger Games, or any EA Sports. “I hope I'm not alone in this. We need to stand up and make our voices heard. I posted on everything I can. We can't let Mass Effect die so easily. Private investors need to realize how badly EA screwed up.” These calls for a boycott coincide with a fanmade petition urging EA to either sell off the IPs to other developers or hand development of Mass Effect 5 to a different studio. At the time of writing, this petition has garnered over 76,500 signatures and counting as more fans and friends of the industry pile in. Mass Effect 5 — which was reportedly expected to be called Mass Effect Universe — seems to have already been a good way into its development cycle, judging by a full-length trailer that was leaked online yesterday. This trailer rubbed even more salt in the wound for players, many of whom believed this game would be everything fans had been asking for and more. Industry vets and even voice actors from the Mass Effect games are speaking out in hopes of somehow, some way, getting this game on shelves. But according to industry analysts and former BioWare bosses , it’s not likely that EA will listen to fans’ demands.

items.title: Save $50 Off the Endlessly Useful ASUS ZenScreen 16" 1080p Portable USB Monitor Ahead of Black Friday
items.excerpt: Doubles as a secondary monitor for your laptop or a portable display for your Nintendo Switch or Steam Deck.
items.content_text: It's no surprise why USB portable monitors are becoming so popular. They provide extra screen real estate for laptop users and they're much slimmer and lighter than your average monitor so you can carry them around. Many newer laptops now have USB ports that can power the monitor so that you don't even need to plug it into an outlet. In addition to boosting productivity on a laptop, the monitor also works as a totable display for your Nintendo Switch. Talk about convenience! Ahead of Black Friday, Amazon is offering the ASUS ZenScreen 15.6" USB Portable Monitor (MB16AHV) for just $99 with free shipping after a $50 off instant discount. There are many portable monitor brands out there, but ASUS is generally considered amongst the highest quality options, especially with its robust 3 year warranty. Save $50 Off the ASUS ZenScreen 16" Portable USB Monitor The ASUS ZenScreen (MB16AHV) is a portable 15.6" monitor that weighs just 2 pounds and measures less than 0.5 inches thin. The plastic housing has been treated with an ionic silver coating "inhibiting 99.9% of bacteria". The monitor features a built-in kickstand and a 1/4" threaded hole for attaching it to a tripod or table mount. The 15.6" IPS display features a 1080p resolution (141ppi), 60Hz refresh rate, wide 178-degree viewing angle, and an anti-glare matte surface. Connectivity options include two USB Type-C ports and one mini HDMI port to connect to a laptop, tablet, or handheld gaming PC for use as a main or secondary display. If your device is equipped with a USB Type-C output with Power Delivery, then a single cable can be used for both video and power. Otherwise, you'll need two cables: a mini HDMI or USB Type-C cable for video and a second USB Type-C cable to a wall charger for power. Compatible with Nintendo Switch or Steam Deck This monitor works quite well paired with a gaming handheld like the Nintendo Switch or Steam Deck. You will have to use the two-cable setup (one USB cable to the handheld, one USB cable to a wall charger) for this to work properly. The 1080p 60Hz panel best complements the Nintendo Switch, since the Switch only supports up to 720p @ 60Hz anyway. The Steam Deck and Switch 2 can support higher resolutions and refresh rates, but at that point you're really taxing your system, and 1080p/60Hz on a smaller display is an ideal balance between visual fidelity and playable framerates. items.title: This Massive 70" 4K Fire TV Drops to a Mere $299.99 With Free Delivery Ahead of Black Friday
items.content_text: Ahead of Black Friday, Best Buy is offering the lowest price I've seen this year for a massive (70" or higher) TV. For this week only, you can pick up the 70" Insignia F50 4K Fire TV for just $299.99 with free shipping. It's sold and shipped by Best Buy direct, not a marketplace vendor, and comes with a 1 year warranty. Early Black Friday Deal: 70" Insignia 4K Fire TV for Just $300 As far as TVs are concerned, my rule of thumb is bigger is better as long as you have enough space. If you're on a budget and want the best bang for your buck, screen size will nearly always make a bigger impression than any other feature. The Insignia F50 is a void-filling 70" TV featuring a native 4K 60Hz display with HDR10 and HLG support and built-in Fire TV. This is a solid TV for PlayStation 5 gaming despite the fact that it doesn't have a native 120Hz refresh rate. Unless you're rocking a PS5 Pro , the vast majority of games can't push past 60fps. Playing Grand Theft Auto 6 on a 70" TV, for example, will be a much more profound real-world experience than playing it on a 120Hz TV. Likewise, the Insignia F50 is a great TV for Nintendo Switch gamers because the Switch 2 only supports 60Hz at 4K in docked mode . For the amount you save compared to getting a higher end TV, you could buy yourself a ton of video games and maybe even another console. For many (probably most) people, that's money better spent.
